Title: Replace in-memory playbook store with SQLite persistence
Implementation Scope: Implement playbook repository + migrations; switch createPlaybookStore() usage in workflow runtime to persistent adapter; keep in-memory adapter for tests.
Acceptance Checklist: Restart keeps playbook/candidate/version/score records; migration chain passes; rollback path documented.
Test Plan: Unit: repository CRUD and conflict tests; Integration: run->restart->select same playbook; E2E: repeated runs reuse promoted playbook.

Title: Apply rules gate globally across execution entrypoints
Implementation Scope: Hook rules evaluation into agent startRun/session run path/skill invoke path; define mandatory scope injection and deny behavior consistency.
Acceptance Checklist: Denied policy blocks execution in enforce mode across all entrypoints; warn mode does not block but emits evidence events.
Test Plan: Unit: policy matrix tests by entrypoint; Integration: agent/session/skill deny cases; Adversarial: bypass attempts fail.

Title: Wire implemented-but-unregistered route families
Implementation Scope: Register routes for multi-tenant, packaging, desktop, observability, marketplace-commerce, discovery, satellite-pairing with feature flags and dependency checks.
Acceptance Checklist: Route contract snapshot includes enabled families; disabled families return explicit capability-off signal; no silent 404 for configured modules.
Test Plan: Contracts: snapshot update; Unit: each route family auth/validation; Smoke: health capabilities reflect registration.

Title: Tenant/owner/satellite authz convergence for evidence and new APIs
Implementation Scope: Standardize principal resolution and tenant boundary checks; apply to evidence export + newly wired route families.
Acceptance Checklist: Cross-tenant access denied with 403; owner/admin have expected access; satellite-bound access scoped correctly.
Test Plan: Integration: RBAC matrix tests; E2E: unauthorized download/policy actions denied; Security regression tests.

Title: Reduce and justify skipped tests in critical suites
Implementation Scope: Replace unconditional skips with implementable coverage or explicit env-gated skips; add skip-budget gate in PR CI for critical paths.
Acceptance Checklist: Critical suites have zero unconditional skips; all remaining skips include env gate + reason tag.
Test Plan: Run check-skipped-tests with strict threshold; CI fails on regression.

Title: Promote cloud live E2E to protected release gate
Implementation Scope: Make cloud live E2E part of release gating policy for main/tag builds; keep manual trigger for ad-hoc runs.
Acceptance Checklist: Main release candidate has passing cloud OpenAI live E2E artifact and logs.
Test Plan: Workflow dispatch + protected environment run; artifact upload validated.

Title: Add evidence retention and storage lifecycle controls
Implementation Scope: Define TTL/retention jobs for run evidence exports and DB traces; expose retention config and operational metrics.
Acceptance Checklist: Retention job runs safely; no orphaned export files; retention policy visible in config/docs.
Test Plan: Unit: retention selector; Integration: export then expire; Ops smoke: no DB/file drift.

Title: Externalize retry policies into managed policy packs
Implementation Scope: Move hardcoded retry policy defaults to structured policy store; add API for policy list/get.
Acceptance Checklist: Retry behavior reproducible from policy pack version; policy change audit trail exists.
Test Plan: Unit: policy loader/validator; Integration: policy switch affects retry decisions deterministically.

Title: Introduce domain acceptance templates
Implementation Scope: Add reusable acceptance packs by workflow type (schema, quant, quality, policy) and bind at compile time.
Acceptance Checklist: At least 3 workflow families use non-baseline acceptance packs; failures clearly actionable.
Test Plan: Unit: evaluator rule coverage; Integration: workflow families pass/fail as expected.

Title: Converter quality scoring and repair loop
Implementation Scope: Add confidence scoring for conversion outputs; add auto-repair retries for invalid manifests/workflows.
Acceptance Checklist: Conversion endpoints return quality score + diagnostics; invalid conversion can auto-repair at least one retry path.
Test Plan: Unit: scorer; Integration: bad input repaired; E2E: import from top formats.

Title: Marketplace mode convergence (stub vs real)
Implementation Scope: Decide and implement runtime mode contract; if stub, return explicit 501/capability payload; if real, wire commerce services.
Acceptance Checklist: Marketplace health capability truthful; no false-available states.
Test Plan: Unit: capability resolver; Integration: stub and real modes; contract tests for mode-specific behavior.

Title: Wire package lifecycle routes and services
Implementation Scope: Instantiate packaging engine and register /v1/packages routes with authz and audit events.
Acceptance Checklist: Package routes appear in contract snapshot and are operational for list/publish/install/rollback flows.
Test Plan: Unit: route handlers + engine; Integration: publish->install->rollback flow; contracts updated.

Title: Wire observability routes with operational backends
Implementation Scope: Bind traces/audit/alerts/SLO route deps to real stores/services; enforce auth scopes.
Acceptance Checklist: /v1/observability routes available when enabled and enforce scope checks.
Test Plan: Unit: route auth; Integration: trace query + alert ack; contract snapshot includes observability paths.

Implementation Scope: Implement chat-first shell + left task rail + workflow/skills panel + run evidence drawer.
Acceptance Checklist: User can chat, create task, create workflow/skill, inspect run evidence without builder jargon.

Implementation Scope: Map frequent command intents to policy-aware UI actions with confirmation levels.
Acceptance Checklist: Buttons only enabled when policy allows; denied actions provide reason + remediation path.
